description: Preflight a Samsung Shannon/Exynos modem session by checking the chipset, root access, known AT ports, and a benign AT handshake together. Optionally sends ATI for identification after a successful handshake. Makes no modem configuration changes.

includeIdentity.description: After a successful AT handshake, also send the read-only ATI identity query

port.description: Optional Shannon device node override (for example /dev/umts_router)

timeout.description: Handshake timeout per port in milliseconds (1000-10000, default 3000)

name: adb_shannon_session
